$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
"Total: {0:N1} GB   Used: {1:N1} GB   Free: {2:N1} GB" -f ($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1MB), (($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize-$os.FreePhysicalMemory)/1MB), ($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB)
